title.narrative: Education for girls who have dropped out of school

description.narrative: 1- Provision of basic equipment for 21 schools for girls' education in the project's targeted areas. 2- Distribution of school bags for 19,000 girls. 3- Providing training programs to develop the capacities of 350 teachers and mentors in the project's targeted areas. 4- Equipping 64 alternative classrooms to ensure that girls are accommodated in displacement camps. 5- Training and empowering 280 female dependents and guardians. 6- Implementation of 14 awareness campaigns encouraging girls' education in Yemen.

Providing equipment in schools, implementing training programs to develop the capabilities of teachers and educational workers, and ensuring educational support for drop-out girls and their families, by implementing awareness and education programs and providing income-generating vocational training programs for parents to ensure that girls continue to study.

Support to confront the dropout of girls from education in the Republic of Yemen, and work to provide support to a number of 19,700 girls who have dropped out of school by providing them with second educational opportunities.
